summary: Verified MongoDB-backed strategies migration end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (6 tests) all pass. Frontend flows: admin login → Estratégias tab → create 'API Test' strategy → POST /api/strategies persists → EM CONSTRUÇÃO tab reads via API polling → strategy visible in PLACAR/scoreboard → trigger 5,10 registered on giro grid. Toggle active/inactive via PUT persists across GET. Delete via DELETE removes from list. No _id leaks in responses.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Strategy Routes: MongoDB calls (find/insert_one/update_one/delete_one) are SYNCHRONOUS (pymongo) inside async FastAPI handlers — they block the event loop. Consider migrating to motor (AsyncIOMotorClient) for consistency with rest of async stack.

list_strategies calls await get_current_user_from_request(request) but ignores its return value while create/update/delete use `user, _ = await ...`. Any authenticated user (including inactive/expired subscriptions) can read strategies — acceptable per spec but worth confirming.
SinaisTab polls /api/strategies every 5s — for many concurrent users this adds constant DB load. Consider Server-Sent Events or WebSocket, or client-side cache with ETag / If-Modified-Since.
getAuthHeaders() in AdminPage.jsx / SinaisTab.jsx duplicated across files — extract to a shared util.
server.py has 1665 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; strategy/auth/payment/blacklist routers should be split into separate modules.
seed_data_creation: Test strategy 'API Test' created and cleaned up during each test run. Pre-existing '8/3' strategy in MongoDB (from prior curl test) left intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Strategy CRUD is fully API-backed via MongoDB collection 'strategies'. Endpoints: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/strategies[/:id]. Admin-only for write. Any authenticated user for read. SinaisTab polls every 5s. Token stored in localStorage.session_token. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_strategies.py is a good regression harness.
